exec_start.description: The full command line to execute for the service. If empty, the default /usr/lib/systemd/systemd-userdbd is used.

extra_env.description: List of environment variable assignments (e.g., KEY=VALUE) to pass to the service. See systemd.service(5) Environment directive.

restart.description: Condition under which the service will be restarted. Valid values: no, on-success, on-failure, on-abnormal, on-watchdog, on-abort, always. See systemd.service(5) Restart directive.

limit_nofile.description: Set the file descriptor limit. 0 means use the default system limit. See systemd.service(5) LimitNOFILE directive.
